who: Historian of modern France at City College and the CUNY Graduate Center; PhD Princeton.

notes: The candidate is Charles G. Rosenberg, a novelist associated with nineteenth-century works, not the CUNY historian Clifford Rosenberg.

who: Historian of women and US social and cultural history at Kansas; history PhD SUNY Binghamton.

Anne Schofield is a jewellery historian and co-author with Kevin Fahy of Australian Jewellery 19th and early 20th century; her professional work is based in Sydney.
